title: 第4章 七灵尘钟
content_zh:
心神紧守丹田，无数的天地灵气疯狂的在下丹田内旋转，巨大的白色漩涡仿佛有灵性似的一点点的扩大。

凝聚剑灵对于普通人来说或许是一件不小的难关，可对曾经是剑神的海天来说却是太轻松不过了。

海天小心翼翼的控制着下丹田内那巨大的白色漩涡，这里面都是已经从天地灵气中转化而来的剑灵力！而剑灵便是有剑灵力凝聚而成的。

此刻海天的剑灵力虽然量已经不少了，可并没有经过提纯，气体状态下的密度比较小，想要凝聚出剑灵来首先就要保证大量的剑灵力做补充。

身体依然在不断的吸收着天地灵气，海天察觉到丹田内转化而来的剑灵力已经足够了。

一不做，二不休，海天立即将心神提了上来，控制着那巨大的白色漩涡，从中提取一缕最精纯的剑灵力。

深吸一口气，海天将心神分成两部分，一部分不断的转化着剑灵力，另外一部分则是小心的开始凝聚剑灵。现在的剑灵力还比较脆弱，必须保证剑灵力不间断的补充。

丹田内那白色漩涡的上方，缓缓的出现了一个乳白色的小点。紧接着，无数的剑灵力疯狂的以这个乳白色的小点为中心不断的凝聚在一起。

没过多久，一把半透明的小剑已经悬挂在海天的丹田内。

可海天却并没有放松，他明白刚才那只是第一步，由于他剑灵力并不精纯的缘故，此刻凝聚出来的剑灵显得相当的稀薄。

现在他需要做的，便是不断的压缩，努力的提高着剑灵的密度。

压缩！极度的压缩！原本有三尺来长的半透明小剑，经过海天那疯狂的压缩，只有三寸了。可海天却并不满意，体内那源源不断转化而来的剑灵力依然补充到那半透明的小剑上去。

然后再次压缩，如此反复好几次，海天才总算是停了下来。

望着丹田内那仅有半寸大小的乳白色小剑，海天长长的呼出一口气，他知道现在这已经是自己能够做到最好的地步了。

剑灵越小，里面的密度则是越大，浓度越高。

令人惊奇的是，自从海天体内的剑灵凝聚成功之后，天地间那疯狂的灵气也停止了运转。

睁开眼睛，望了一眼已经全身湿透的衣衫，海天脸上带有一丝苦涩：“没想到竟然会变成这样，这也幸亏是我，如果换一个人的话，就算不自爆而亡也得走火入魔了。”

想到这里，海天庆幸的笑了笑，刚才那一步步都相当的凶险，一方面要尽量控制天地灵气不要进入过快，还要不断的转化，而另外一方面还要凝聚剑灵。

这两方面无论疏漏了哪一点都会给海天造成致命的打击，这也就海天这个剑神的灵魂才能够坚持下来，换一个人恐怕就灰飞湮灭了。

“才刚刚一段剑之力便凝聚成剑灵了，也不知道这日后到达一星剑士会怎么样？”海天检查了下自身，发现自己已经达到一段剑之力了，脸上不仅没有一丝欣喜，反而愁眉不展。

按照常理来说，只有达到一星剑士才有可能凝聚出剑灵来，可现在刚刚修炼《九天神剑诀》就凝聚出剑灵来了，也不知道是他自己一人这样还是都这样？

苦恼的摇了摇头，海天站起身来，将身上湿漉漉的衣服脱下，穿着湿衣服的感觉可不好。

然而当他还没有穿好衣服的时候，忽然一阵沉闷的钟声便响了起来：“咚——咚——”。

“这是七灵尘钟？怎么会这个时候响起来？”海天紧皱着眉头。所谓的七灵尘钟，是海家的一件宝贝，是用来召集全海家人聚集的信号。不过这个七灵尘钟只有海家最高权力阶层才能发出。无论你们此时在做什么，必须在短时间内赶到。

所谓的最高权力阶层，是指海家家主，也就是他父亲海无涯以及三位长老。

三位长老海天几乎没有见过面，对他们并不了解。

迅速换好了衣服，海天便走出了房门，心中正好奇的猜测着他父亲为何要召集他们所有人？难道出了什么大事？

“咦，小雨！这是怎么回事？你知不知道父亲他为何要召集我们所有人？”海天没走多远就遇上了放下纸笔匆匆而来的小雨。

“天哥！你怎么换了一件衣服？”小雨见到海天换了一件衣服，颇为惊讶，不过却转念摇头道，“我也不知道大伯为何要召集我们，刚才我还在书房里抄录呢，现在都没抄完。”

“看样子出了一件惊天动地的大事了，不然父亲不会这么召集我们的。”海天沉吟了半天也猜想不出到底发生了何事，只得带着小雨匆匆向着大厅赶去。

一路上遇上了不少像他们这样的，许多平常见不到面的人也都纷纷走了出来。海天和他们并不熟悉，只是望了几眼便匆匆离去。

不一会儿，海天和小雨两人便来到了海家大厅中。

此时大厅内已经站立了许多人，初步估计至少已经有上百人了。海天还是第一次见到海家原来有这么多人呢。

在大厅的正中央，海无涯已经面色凝重的坐在首位上，他的身边也坐着三名须发皆白的老者，海天明白那可能就是海家的三位长老。

钟声持续了一会儿就停了，不过外面依然有不少海家子弟赶过来。

海云带着几个亲信匆忙赶过来，由于他是海家直系子弟的身份，在这海家大厅内也是有着自己的座位。可眼前人山人海的，想要挤过去可并不太容易。

“闪开！”海云对着前面的人厉声喝道。

前面的那海家子弟原本还想出言叫骂几句，可一看到是海云边蔫了，直接放他过去。其他人也都纷纷让开了一条通道。

可没走多远，海云便见到小雨挡着他的去路，再瞥眼就望见了小雨身旁的海天，心中一阵恼火，再次出言喝道：“滚开！”

“什么？你叫我滚开？”小雨也不是善茬，如果海云好好说的话，小雨恐怕会让出来。可是海云这样说的话，小雨是无论如何都不会让开的！

“叫你滚就滚，哪那么多废话！”海云十分不屑的瞪了一眼小雨，由于海天的影响，使得海云对小雨的态度也十分的恶劣。

如果换作是别人，恐怕会退让一步，可小雨却不会，出言反击道：“我不会滚，你给我示范一个看看？”

“你！”海云没有想到小雨竟然敢出言顶撞自己，心头的怒火一下子窜了上来，狠狠的瞪着小雨道，“小子，你找打是吗？”

眼见小雨和海云就要冲突起来，海天不动声色的拉住了小雨，对他轻轻的摇了摇头：“小雨，人家要过就让他过呗？你跟他吵架会降低自己的智商的。”

原本海天是不打算跟海云有冲突的，可海云这样欺负小雨，海天是绝对不会坐视不管的。

小雨听得一楞，立即反应过来，连连点头：“天哥，你说得很对。我跟他吵架岂不是说我的智商也要变得跟他一样了？”

两人的一唱一和，让海云的脸色十分的难看。

周围的海家子弟们一个个都是想笑又不敢笑的样子，都忍得十分的辛苦。他们可没有海天和小雨这样的胆子以及身份敢与海云正面作对。

似乎感觉到周围传来那嘲讽的目光，海云的怒火一下子就爆发了，他立即跳了起来，指着海天大声喝道：“你说什么？你说谁智商低？”

“小雨，我有说他智商低吗？”海天脸上一副无辜的表情。

小雨也是非常配合的摇头：“天哥，你从头到尾都没有说他智商低啊？”

“那奇怪了，他为什么要跳出来承认自己智商低？难道说他真得是——低能儿！”海天一本正经的叹了口气，“大哥，不是我说你，早点去找个高手看看吧，这样怎么能承担得起我们海家的一片天空？”

“哈哈哈……”海天这声情并茂的表演，让在场的众人是再也忍不住了，纷纷捂着肚子哈哈大笑起来。

就连海云身后的那几个跟班都忍不住笑起来，气得海云狠狠的瞪了他们一眼：“笑什么笑？都不许笑！”

迫于海云的实力以及身份，众人都不得不捂住自己的嘴巴，但是看得出来，他们脸上的表情都十分的扭曲，依然在偷偷的笑着。

“你！海天！”海云双眼冒火的望着海天，心中的怒火已经升到了顶点，“我要跟你决斗！就是现在！”

在魂剑大陆上，当一方提出决斗，另外一方是不可以拒绝的。不过如果提出决斗方的实力比被决斗方的实力强太多的话，被决斗方是有权拒绝的。

“我为什么要和你决斗？凭你那六段剑之力来欺负我吗？”海天的目光中闪过一丝轻蔑，就凭海云这气度，日后的成就肯定不会高。

剑者到后来的修炼，看得并不仅仅是功力，更重要的是对天地的体悟，对境界的升华。

谁都知道，海云此刻可是六段剑之力的高手，而海天才刚刚开始选择修炼功法，两人之间完全没有可比性。

周围众人都不由得对海云指指点点，就凭他这样的城府，怎么能成为海家的继承人？

坐在上位的三位长老，眼神中都闪过一丝不满。

“够了！”一直都没有出声的海无涯忽然喝道，脸上一片严肃。

原本喧闹的大厅立即安静了下来，毕竟在这个海家，海无涯的话语权可是极大的。即使是海云也不得不在海无涯面前收敛几分，只得恨恨的瞪着海天。
content_en:
Keeping your mind close to your Dantian, countless spiritual energy from heaven and earth swirled crazily in your lower Dantian, and the huge white vortex expanded bit by bit as if it had spiritual power.

Condensing the sword spirit may be a big difficulty for ordinary people, but it is too easy for Hai Tian, ​​who was once the sword god.

Hai Tian carefully controlled the huge white vortex in his lower dantian, which contained the sword spiritual power that had been transformed from the spiritual energy of heaven and earth!The sword spirit is formed by the condensed sword spirit power.

Although Haitian's sword spirit power is quite abundant at this moment, it has not been purified, and the density in the gas state is relatively small. If he wants to condense the sword spirit power, he must first ensure a large amount of sword spirit power to supplement it.

His body was still absorbing the spiritual energy of heaven and earth, and Hai Tian realized that the sword spiritual power transformed from his dantian was enough.

Without stopping, Hai Tian immediately raised his mind, controlled the huge white vortex, and extracted the purest sword spirit power from it.

Taking a deep breath, Hai Tian divided his mind into two parts. One part was constantly transforming the sword spirit power, and the other part was carefully starting to condense the sword spirit.The current sword spirit power is still relatively fragile, and it is necessary to ensure that the sword spirit power is continuously replenished.

Above the white vortex in the dantian, a small milky white dot slowly appeared.Immediately afterwards, countless sword spirits gathered together crazily around this milky white dot.

Not long after, a translucent small sword was already hanging in Hai Tian's dantian.

But Hai Tian did not relax. He understood that it was just the first step. Because his sword spirit power was not pure, the sword spirit condensed at this moment seemed quite thin.

What he needs to do now is to continuously compress and work hard to increase the density of the sword spirit.

compression!Extreme compression!The small translucent sword that was originally three feet long was reduced to only three inches after Hai Tian's crazy compression.But Hai Tian was not satisfied. The sword spirit power continuously transformed in his body still replenished the translucent little sword.

Then he compressed again, repeated several times, and finally Hai Tian stopped.

Looking at the small milky white sword that was only half an inch in size in his dantian, Hai Tian exhaled a long breath. He knew that now this was the best he could do.

The smaller the sword spirit, the greater the density and concentration inside it.

What is surprising is that since the sword spirit in Hai Tian's body was successfully condensed, the crazy spiritual energy between heaven and earth also stopped moving.

Opening his eyes and looking at his soaked clothes, Hai Tian had a hint of bitterness on his face: "I didn't expect it would turn out like this. Fortunately, it was me. If it were another person, he would have gone crazy even if he didn't self-destruct."

Thinking of this, Hai Tian smiled happily. The steps just now were quite dangerous. On the one hand, he had to control the spiritual energy of heaven and earth not to enter too fast, and to continuously transform it. On the other hand, he had to condense the sword spirit.

Any omission in these two aspects will cause a fatal blow to Haitian. Only the soul of Haitian, the sword god, can persevere. If it were another person, he would have been wiped out.

"I have just condensed a level of sword power into a sword spirit. I wonder what will happen if I become a one-star swordsman in the future?" Hai Tian checked himself and found that he had already reached a level of sword power. Not only was there no trace of joy on his face, but he was frowning.

According to common sense, only a one-star swordsman can condense the sword spirit. But now he has condensed the sword spirit just after practicing the "Nine Heavens Divine Sword Art". I don't know if it is just him or everyone?

Shaking his head in distress, Hai Tian stood up and took off his wet clothes. Wearing wet clothes didn't feel good.

However, when he had not yet put on his clothes, suddenly a dull bell rang: "Dong-dong-".

"Is this the Seven Spiritual Dust Bell? Why is it ringing at this time?" Hai Tian frowned.The so-called Seven Spiritual Dust Bell is a treasure of the Hai family and is used as a signal to summon the entire Hai family to gather.However, this Seven Soul Bell can only be issued by the highest power level of the Hai family.No matter what you are doing at this time, you must arrive in a short time.

The so-called highest power class refers to the head of the Hai family, his father Hai Wuya and the three elders.

The three elders Hai Tian have barely met each other and don't know much about them.

After quickly changing his clothes, Hai Tian walked out of the room, curiously wondering why his father summoned all of them?Did something big happen?

"Hey, Xiaoyu! What's going on? Do you know why father summoned all of us?" Hai Tian didn't go far when he met Xiaoyu who put down his pen and paper and came in a hurry.

"Brother Tian! Why did you change clothes?" Xiao Yu was quite surprised to see Hai Tian changed clothes, but then she changed her mind and shook her head, "I don't know why uncle summoned us. I was copying in the study just now, and I haven't finished copying yet."

"It seems that something earth-shattering has happened, otherwise father wouldn't have summoned us like this." Hai Tian pondered for a long time but couldn't figure out what happened, so he had to rush toward the hall with Xiao Yu.

I met many people like them along the way, and many people I would never see in person also came out one after another.Hai Tian was not familiar with them, so he just glanced at them and left in a hurry.

After a while, Hai Tian and Xiao Yu came to the Hai Family Hall.

At this time, many people were already standing in the hall. It was initially estimated that there were at least hundreds of people.This was the first time that Hai Tian saw so many people in the Hai family.

In the center of the hall, Hai Wuya was sitting at the head with a solemn expression. Next to him were three old men with white hair and beards. Hai Tian knew that they might be the three elders of the Hai family.

The bell lasted for a while and then stopped, but there were still many Hai family disciples coming outside.

Hai Yun hurried over with a few close friends. Because he was a direct descendant of the Hai family, he also had his own seat in the Hai family hall.But there were so many people in front of us, it was not easy to squeeze through.

"Get out of the way!" Haiyun shouted sharply at the person in front of him.

The Hai family boy in front originally wanted to yell and curse a few words, but when he saw that Hai Yun was wilting, he let him pass.Everyone else also made way for a passage.

But not far away, Haiyun saw Xiaoyu blocking his way. He glanced again and saw Haitian beside Xiaoyu. He felt annoyed in his heart and shouted again: "Get away!"

"What? You told me to go away?" Xiao Yu is not a good person. If Hai Yun talks nicely, Xiao Yu might let him out.But if Haiyun said this, Xiaoyu would not give way under any circumstances!

"Go away if I tell you, there is so much nonsense!" Haiyun glared at Xiaoyu with disdain. Due to Haitian's influence, Haiyun's attitude towards Xiaoyu was also very bad.

If it were someone else, I'm afraid he would give in, but Xiaoyu would not. He retorted: "I don't know how to get out, can you show me an example?"

"You!" Haiyun didn't expect that Xiaoyu would dare to contradict him. The anger in his heart suddenly surged up, and he glared at Xiaoyu fiercely and said, "Boy, are you looking for a beating?"

Seeing that Xiao Yu and Hai Yun were about to have a conflict, Hai Tian calmly held Xiao Yu in hand and shook his head gently: "Xiao Yu, if someone wants to pass, just let him pass? If you argue with him, your IQ will be lowered."

Originally, Hai Tian did not intend to conflict with Hai Yun, but Hai Tian would never sit idly by when Hai Yun bullied Xiao Yu like this.

Xiaoyu was stunned when he heard it, and immediately reacted and nodded repeatedly: "Brother Tian, you are right. If I quarrel with him, doesn't it mean that my IQ will become the same as his?"

The two of them sang together, making Haiyun's face look very ugly.

The surrounding Hai family disciples all looked like they wanted to laugh but did not dare to laugh. They were all enduring very hard.They don't have the courage and status to confront Hai Yun like Hai Tian and Xiao Yu.

As if he felt the mocking glances coming from around him, Hai Yun's anger suddenly burst out. He immediately jumped up, pointed at Hai Tian and shouted loudly: "What did you say? Who are you saying has a low IQ?"

"Xiao Yu, did I say he has a low IQ?" Hai Tian had an innocent expression on his face.

Xiaoyu also shook his head very cooperatively: "Brother Tian, you never said that he has a low IQ from the beginning to the end?"

"That's strange. Why did he jump out and admit that he has a low IQ? Could it be that he is really - an imbecile!" Hai Tian sighed seriously, "Brother, I'm not telling you, go find a master as soon as possible. How can you afford our Hai family's sky?"

"Hahaha..." Hai Tian's emotional performance made everyone present unable to hold back any longer, and they all held their stomachs and laughed.

Even the followers behind Haiyun couldn't help but laugh. Haiyun was so angry that he glared at them fiercely: "Why are you laughing? No one is allowed to laugh!"

Due to Haiyun's strength and identity, everyone had to cover their mouths, but it could be seen that the expressions on their faces were very distorted, and they were still smiling secretly.

"You! Hai Tian!" Hai Yun looked at Hai Tian with blazing eyes, and the anger in his heart had reached its peak, "I want to duel with you! Now!"

On the Soul Sword Continent, when one party proposes a duel, the other party cannot refuse.However, if the dueling party is much stronger than the dueling party, the dueling party has the right to refuse.

"Why should I duel with you? Are you bullying me with the power of your six-level sword?" A trace of contempt flashed in Hai Tian's eyes. With Hai Yun's demeanor, his future achievements will definitely not be high.

When a swordsman later cultivates, he not only considers his skill, but more importantly, his understanding of heaven and earth and his sublimation of realm.

Everyone knew that Hai Yun was a master of the six-level sword power at the moment, while Hai Tian had just started to choose to practice the technique, so there was no comparison between the two.

Everyone around him couldn't help but point fingers at Hai Yun. How could he become the heir of the Hai family with a city like his?

The three elders sitting at the top all had a trace of dissatisfaction in their eyes.

"That's enough!" Hai Wuya, who had been silent until now, suddenly shouted, with a serious look on his face.

The originally noisy hall immediately fell silent. After all, in this Hai family, Hai Wuya had a huge say.Even Hai Yun had to restrain himself a bit in front of Hai Wuya, and could only glare at Hai Tian bitterly.
